auth.signup.title: Create account
auth.signup.nicknameHint: 4–16 lowercase letters, no numbers, spaces or symbols. It is your public handle, unique and cannot be changed later.

auth.signup.agree: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

account.privacy.help: Your ratings stay in the community scores, but your profile and lists are hidden from other users.
account.privacy.personalizationHelp: We stop using your ratings to suggest items to you.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.body: Your account is deleted 30 days after you confirm. Until then you can log in and cancel.
account.delete.dialogBody: You will be logged out now. If you do not log in and cancel within 30 days, your personal data is erased for good. Your ratings remain in the community scores as an anonymous user.

account.export.cooldown: You can request one export every 7 days. Try again later.

account.crashReports.title: Send crash reports?
account.crashReports.body: If the app crashes, send the app version, Android version, screen and error details to HexaScore. No account, e-mail or token is included. You can turn this off in Settings.
